verdict.rationale: A data-training opt-out is a fair question for a commerce platform that shares merchant and shopper data with AI platforms, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. The feed-sync and tokenization material covers data sharing and security, not training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
